title: SRE oncall scratchpad - 2026-03-13
content:
Summary:
- Oncall shift 2026-03-13 (Lena). Primary pager: hosted-api routing errors -> cascading fallbacks to smaller models -> increased tail latency for several customers.
- Incident ID: INC-2026-03-13-01. Priority: P2 (customer impact, elevated error rate but partial fallback maintained availability).

Timeline (local times):
- 02:07 UTC: Pager alert -> hosted-api model routing error rate > 5% for 3m (alert: routing-failure-rate-high).
- 02:10 UTC: I jumped in, checked #infra-alerts and routing service logs. Observed timeouts to model-selector service (selector) and spikes in 504s from selector -> runtime.
- 02:14 UTC: Enabled temporary fallback rule (route to stable-variant-v3) via the Console to reduce errors — reduced visible errors for customers ~02:18.
- 02:22 UTC: Postmortem prelim notes started. Escalated to Platform Eng (tagged @noah_chen) for deeper selector investigation.
- 03:00 UTC: Reduced alert frequency and suppressed noisy alerts; monitoring continues.

Immediate findings / hypotheses:
- Root cause likely transient connection pool exhaustion in model-selector when several deployments rolled at once (see customer X rollout spikes around 02:05 UTC).
- Selector timed out to runtime when kernel negotiation stretched due to concurrent model cold-starts.
- No evidence of hardware OOM or GPU kernel failures — infra metrics (node mem/CPU) within normal range.

Actions taken during shift:
- Applied on-console fallback policy to stable-variant-v3 (manual override) to stop cascading model fallbacks.
- Increased selector request timeout from 1500ms -> 3000ms as a stopgap (rollback to 1500ms planned after root cause).
- Raised a Jira SRE ticket (SRE-4821) to track RCA and follow-ups.
- Opened GH PR to add more defensive retries in selector client (link in artifacts).

Follow-ups / Runbook TODOs (owner / due):
1) Add connection pool metrics and alert for selector (new metric: selector.conn_pool_utilization). Owner: Alex Martin. Due: 2026-03-17.
2) Update routing failover runbook to include "apply manual fallback + increase timeout" play. Owner: Lena Garcia. Due: 2026-03-16. (Confluence page linked)
3) Implement safe backoff on concurrent model rollout to avoid selector overload (platform change). Owner: Noah Chen. Due: 2026-03-27.
4) Add automated test that simulates concurrent cold-starts and validates selector behavior under 50 concurrent new model loads. Owner: Sophia Wong. Due: 2026-03-24.
5) Roll back temporary timeout increase after selector fix and measure error rate. Owner: Lena Garcia. Due: post-fix (TBD).

Notes to self / quick TODOs for next shift:
- Remind Platform Eng to include rollout rate-limiting in rollout checklist (link to GH PR).
- Check customer X support ticket once RCA published, prepare a short blurb for CS. Owner: Lena.
- Make small dashboard: per-customer fallback rate + selector 5xxs (use existing dashboard template).

Unresolved questions:
- Why did connection pool exhaustion occur without node-level resource saturation? Hypothesis: selector threadpool saturating due to long-running kernel negotiation RPCs -> need flamegraph / pprof of selector around 02:05. (Action: request pprof from runtime team)
- Is the increased timeout masking an underlying perf regression in kernel negotiation code? (Action: add tracing to kernel negotiation path)

Logs / commands used (for handoff):
- kubectl logs -n infra svc/model-selector-0 --since=10m | grep "timeout"
- curl -sS "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/route/override" -X POST -d '{"route":"stable-variant-v3","ttl":600}'  # used via Console UI
- grafana link: /d/redwood/sre-hosted-routing?from=now-2h&to=now

Handoff notes for next oncall (Sophia):
- Monitor selector.conn_pool_utilization (new ephemeral metric I asked Alex for) and routing-fallback-rate.
- If fallback rate > 2% for > 30m, revert manual timeout change and open emergency call with platform-eng.

Retrospective items (to include in postmortem):
- Improve rollout throttling safety: platform rollout should gate model-selector QPS.
- Add per-customer impact metrics to prioritize mitigation.
- Hardening: add token bucket limiting in selector to avoid head-of-line blocking from a few noisy rollouts.

References / links: SRE-4821 (Jira), PR #2893 (selector client retries), Confluence runbook (Routing Failover). Slack: #sre-oncall, #infra-alerts, #platform-rollouts.

Freeform notes (brain dump):
- Felt a little slow to react because some of the older runbook steps were out of date (timeouts and Console path changed). Schedule a runbook sync meeting after RCA.
- Consider a "canary impact" metric when customers trigger model redeploys as part of CI checks.
- Leave a small checklist in the Console UI for canary -> rollout that prompts rate-limit selection (low/medium/high).

End of shift checklist completed: yes. Leaving a short blurb for CS and tagging follow-ups.

- Lena
